scope: Local compatibility assembly only, not a fourth completed building. Two images are Blender studio renders, not Unity screenshots. No full-house decoration, entrance, furnishing or containment criteria applied.

images.observation: 修订后的局部组合棚拍实际复看：梁架、地板、侧填充与前山墙主形相对放置连贯，侧斜撑在可见部分到横档的交接比首轮完整；无可见大范围穿插或新增大片黑接头。地板重复纹、墙底/柱边亮缝仍见，不是实机或密闭房体证据。
修订后的前视实际复看：地板在两前柱内，山墙与梁架主形一致，山墙斜边到椽下连续开放带仍在；是通风留空型局部兼容展示，不能称防雨封闭建筑。不能由这张正视验证背斜撑深度接触，已另以侧墙左右/背图复查。

findings: Visible major frame/floor/gable/side-infill placement is coherent; no obvious broad interpenetration or newly detached support visible in these two views.
Detached side-brace blocker has separately been resolved by actual back/left/right review of side-infill attempt2.
